title: Lost Mary Maryliq Tropical Island 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Lose yourself in the luxurious medley of tropical fruits with Lost Mary Maryliq's Tropical Island. This e-liquid whisks you away to a beachside getaway where Pineapples, Lemon, and Mango coalesce into a divine tropical cocktail. Each puff is a blissful escape, delivering a flavour burst that's both exotic and invigorating. The 50% VG / 50% PG ratio ensures a well-rounded vaping experience, offering a smooth throat hit along with flavourful clouds. Whether you're new to vaping or a seasoned pro, this e-liquid is a tropical treat that's sure to lift your spirits and brighten your day.
